description: This Java source file defines the OverlayWindowActivity class, an Android activity that demonstrates how to display and manage overlay windows (drawn over other apps). It includes permission handling for overlay display, creating overlay views, and interacting with the WindowManager.

classes.name: OverlayWindowActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates overlay window display, permission request, and removal.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and assigns click handlers to buttons.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result after the user responds to the overlay permission request.

methods.name: drawOverlay
methods.description: Creates and adds an overlay TextView to the window using WindowManager.
